summary: Arq, Inc. filed an 8-K announcing the appointment of Peter Owino, 52, as Chief Accounting Officer, effective September 1, 2026. Owino had served as Interim CAO via Princeton Business Consulting. He receives a $350,000 base salary, 55% STI target, 75% LTI target, and 100,000 restricted stock units vesting over three years as an inducement grant outside the 2026 Omnibus Incentive Plan. No abrupt departure or forced change is indicated; the appointment appears routine and planned, with no strategic or financial restructuring implications. Watch for future filings on executive compensation or potential changes in financial leadership.
